items.markdown:
The second-class air-conditioned sleeper train from Bangkok to Chiang Mai is `a popular, budget-friendly overnight journey taking roughly 13 hours` . Tickets cost between 758 and 1,338 THB depending on whether you book a lower or upper bunk and if you purchase at the station or online.[](https://www.thailandtrains.com/buy-train-tickets-from-bangkok-to-chiang-mai/) [[1]](https://www.thailandtrains.com/buy-train-tickets-from-bangkok-to-chiang-mai/)[[2]](https://thai-railways.com/en/Thai-Train-Fleet?ref=search)[[3]](https://www.thailandtrains.com/seat-types-on-thailand-trains/)[[4]](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DYcdQ0jHB8p/?hl=en-gb)

Schedule and Route Details

- **Departure Station:** Krung Thep Aphiwat Central Terminal (Bang Sue Grand) in Bangkok.
- **Key Trains:** Special Express trains No. 9 (departing around 18:40) and No. 13 (departing around 20:05).
- **Travel Time:** Approximately 13 hours, arriving in Chiang Mai the following morning between 07:15 and 08:40 or later depending on the specific run.[](https://www.thaitrainguide.com/trains/sleepers/) [[1]](https://www.thaitrainguide.com/trains/sleepers/)[[2]](https://12go.asia/en/operator/thai-railways)[[3]](https://www.seat61.com/Thailand.htm)

Onboard Experience and Berths

- **Lower vs. Upper Bunks:** Lower bunks are slightly more expensive, wider, feature a larger window, and lack the overhead direct air-conditioning vent blast of the upper bunks.[](https://www.thailandtrains.com/seat-types-on-thailand-trains/) 
- **Amenities:** Each bed includes a clean pillow, a privacy curtain, and a fresh blanket.[](https://www.thailandtrains.com/seat-types-on-thailand-trains/) 
- **Facilities:** Carriages are open-plan bunk style (dormitory style down the aisle) with shared western and Asian style toilets at the ends of the cars.[](https://www.thailandtrains.com/seat-types-on-thailand-trains/) [[1]](https://iamkohchang.com/blog/bangkok-chiangmai-sleeper-train9.html)

Booking and Tips

- **Purchasing:** You can buy tickets at station ticket windows or online via platforms like 12Go.
- **Advance Booking:** Book days or weeks ahead during peak travel seasons, as lower bunks sell out very quickly.
- **Food:** While some trains may have limited food options, it is smart to carry bottled water and snacks or buy food from station vendors before departure.[](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pkGn2fkB4B0&t=9) [[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pkGn2fkB4B0&t=9)[[2]](https://www.tripadvisor.co.uk/ShowUserReviews-g293917-d9461240-r465818828-Chiang_Mai_Railway_Station-Chiang_Mai.html)
